ipxact:field.ipxact:name: BUSY
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Status for the active stream: bits [7:0] each indicate readiness to accept another command, bit 8 is zero, and bit 9 indicates midend activity. These bits do not report backend busy or prove transfer completion; use DONE for completed transfer IDs. Unused streams read zero.
